request: User liked Flying but wanted the sheet to bend around itself, rather than only flutter in wind.

behavior.Flutter: Exact original output retained, including old projects without Movement.
behavior.Roll: Whole sheet periodically winds and unwinds through up to 540 degrees.
behavior.Loop: Whole sheet stays in an open changing coil, 306–450 degrees.
behavior.Corkscrew: A complete helical twist travels through the sheet.
behavior.controls: Movement; Motion amount 0–100%; Motion along Width/Length. Existing waves/twist/edge curl combine with the new profiles.
behavior.geometry: Small spiral pitch separates wraps. Fixed centre/framing, two-sided hidden surfaces, final attachment envelope and whole-output point budgets retained. Perspective stays in front of the camera at extreme inputs.
behavior.amountZero: Exact previous Flutter geometry and framing, not an approximately flat new projection.

validation.legacy: Seven exact parent Flutter comparisons plus nine original Draped/Hanging/Flag comparisons and original Drape validator pass.
validation.geometry: Independent full-turn measurements prove Roll/Loop bend the whole sheet more than 360 degrees, approximate arc-length retention, separated ends, full Corkscrew winding, both axes, fixed anchors for every profile, exact loops, fixed framing and extreme pre-clamp bounds.
validation.lint: No errors/warnings in modified helper, examples and preview/validation tools. Existing Drape unused-variable warnings are unchanged.

nativeBrowser.controls: Movement, amount 0/100, axis change and next frame exercised. Final fresh reload shows Roll preset; no warnings/errors since reload.

validation.learnRecapture: The exact documented Craft Flag graph was recaptured through the actual Help starter: static SVG and all twelve Timeline SVG frames match stored historical bytes. Drape/helper provenance refreshed, historical PNG dates retained; full shared gate green.

media: Three new GIFs render actual node strokes; six self-contained projects and SVGs. These renders are not browser screenshots.
limitations: Analytic motion profiles with geometry blending; cloth/object collisions are not simulated.
